Do More With The Innovive System

The Innovive System is a comprehensive end-to-end animal husbandry solution that features our high-performance IVC racks and our single-use, disposable cages.

Get started

High performance IVC Innorack

  • Dual HEPA-filtered ventilation system
  • Single and double-sided options, multiple configurations
  • Dynamic digital controller
Mouse racks
Rat racks

Single-use, recyclable disposable Innocage®

  • We offer a variety of rodent cage sizes and lids to accommodate all types of research
  • Made of 100% high viscosity PET, BPA-free, fully recyclable
  • Patented lightweight thin-wall caging
Mouse caging
Rat caging

All Innovive plastic components arrive:

Irradiated

Double-Bagged

BPA Free

Recyclable

Caging delivered ready for use

  • All products arrive securely double-bagged and irradiated, and immediately ready for research
  • Options for pre-bedded cages (corn cob, Biofresh or ALPHA-dri®), pre-enriched cages (Innorichment) and pre-filled water bottles (Aquavive)
Get started

Dirty cage processing simplified

  • Innovive offers a dedicated recycling service that picks up dirty bedded cages from your facility and processes them for you.
  • Our system eliminates much of the laborious activities of a traditional washable caging system, such as cage washing and sterilizing.
  • Once disposable cages are used, the dirty bedding is dumped and the cages can be fully recycled.
Mouse caging
Rat caging

Disposable vs. Washable Caging

The diagrams below provide a comparison between a washable and a disposable caging facility. It illustrates the simplified process and material flow that occurs in a disposable caging facility.

WASHABLE CAGING

DISPOSABLE CAGING

Water Process

  • Innovive offers multiple water bottle solutions, including pre-filled water in choices of acidified, chlorinated or ultra purified.
  • We follow a strictly controlled multi-step water formulation process to ensure that bottles are filled with the highest quality water for your animals.
Learn More

INNO+ VIVARIUM SOLUTIONS

Your Science, Our Care

Beyond equipment, Innovive’s Inno+ team delivers flexible, scalable vivarium staffing and expert animal care 365 days a year — so your scientists stay focused on the research.

Explore Inno+

Recycling with Innocycle

The Innovive Closed-Loop Recycling Service allows you to easily recycle your used disposable caging with bedding still intact. The recycling service not only helps to eliminate the burden of cage dumping and processing, but also helps to significantly reduce your environmental impact.

Learn more

Get in Touch!

We’re always happy to hear from you. Whether you’re interested in our products, services, partnerships, or just want to learn more about us, please fill out the contact form. We appreciate your interest and look forward to connecting with you!

Contact Us
